claim: Deep ensemble diversity arises because independently initialized/trained members converge to different modes of the loss landscape, producing genuine functional diversity that single-model subspace-sampling methods (MC-dropout, SWAG) fail to replicate.
stance_target: mechanistic explanation for why ensemble disagreement (sigma) exists at all
scope_conditions: image classification (CIFAR-10 etc.), comparison of ensembling vs. subspace-sampling methods
quoted_support: improving accuracy, uncertainty and out-of-distribution robustness of deep learning

stance_target: whether this paper can be used to bound the audited paper's distance-signal claim
